ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels across the lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and along the trailing edge borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric regions occupy the majority of the left and right lobes. A dark, low-intensity triangular region extends from the fluke base toward the center. Small, isolated dark focal spots are visible on the right lobe at approximate coordinates [mid-right] and [lower-right].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-55 degrees; the depth is moderately deep relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge features high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude peaks and valleys, culminating in a large, jagged indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips; the right lobe distal tip is notably more blunt and irregular than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least four distinct, roughly circular dark pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe, and two smaller clusters on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel texture and non-linear boundary disruption at the right distal tip, consistent with physical trauma or heavy barnacle colonization resulting in permanent tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in distal tip morphology: the left tip is smooth and tapered, while the right tip is blunt, jagged, and heavily textured.
